newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ImmuLogic started at buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ImmuLogic started at buy.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said analyst Richard van den Broek started coverage of ImmuLogic Pharmaceuticals Inc with a buy rating based on two lead products, Allervax Cat and Allervax Ragweed, that are in late stages of clinical evaluation.
-- In a statement, van den Broek said the company believes it could file for approval of both drugs in 1997.

-- The stock's near term performance will depend on data from Allervax Ragweed's ongoing phase II/III studies set to be released in first quarter 1997 and on data from an additial study of Allervax Cat.
-- Shares of Immulogic were up 1/8 at 8-7/8 by midday.
